title: Tiny, cute yo-yo
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- string -->
  <path d='M50 42 C50 30, 52 22, 54 14' stroke='#e0e8f0' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- finger loop at top -->
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='11' rx='5' ry='4' fill='none' stroke='#e0e8f0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- left disc -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='58' rx='16' ry='18' fill='#ff5a3c'/>
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='58' rx='16' ry='18' fill='#ff7a5c' transform='translate(-1,-1)' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- right disc -->
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='58' rx='16' ry='18' fill='#ff5a3c'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='58' rx='16' ry='18' fill='#ff7a5c' transform='translate(1,-1)' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- disc rims -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='58' rx='16' ry='18' fill='none' stroke='#ffd0a0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='58' rx='16' ry='18' fill='none' stroke='#ffd0a0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- left disc shine -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='52' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#ffb0a0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- right disc shine -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='52' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#ffb0a0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- center axle -->
  <rect x='46' y='46' width='8' height='24' rx='3' fill='#ffd44d'/>
  <rect x='47' y='47' width='3' height='22' rx='1.5' fill='#ffe89a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- center hub -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='9' fill='#ffd44d'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='9' fill='none' stroke='#ffe89a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='4' fill='#ff7a5c'/>
  <circle cx='48.5' cy='56.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffe89a' opacity='0.9'/>
  <!-- little face on hub: eyes -->
  <circle cx='47' cy='57' r='1.2' fill='#3a2a20'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='57' r='1.2' fill='#3a2a20'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M47.5 60 Q50 62.5 52.5 60' stroke='#3a2a20' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
